AddFIDO2Passkey.title: How to create a passkey
AddFIDO2Passkey.step1Description: There will be a pop-up on your device. You may have to enable passkey or your password manager on your device to get started.
AddFIDO2Passkey.step2: If prompted, choose an email to create your passkey with.
AddFIDO2Passkey.selectEmailOnly: Make sure you select an email only.
AddFIDO2Passkey.step3: Follow the remaining steps in the pop-up.
AddFIDO2Passkey.deviceWarning: Make sure you only create a passkey on a device

AddFIDO2PasskeyNickname.title: Name your passkey
AddFIDO2PasskeyNickname.description: Give your passkey a memorable name that helps you remember what device you created it on.
AddFIDO2PasskeyNickname.label: Passkey name

VerifyFIDO2Passkey.title: Verify with your passkey
VerifyFIDO2Passkey.description: There will be a pop-up on your device asking for your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
VerifyFIDO2Passkey.helpLink: Help with signing in with a passkey

DeleteFIDO2PasskeyConfirm.title: Are you sure you want to delete this passkey?
DeleteFIDO2PasskeyConfirm.noLongerUse: You will no longer be able to use your passkey
DeleteFIDO2PasskeyConfirm.deleteFromContact: delete this number from your contact information. To manage your contact phone number, go to

DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.title: Remove passkey from your device (optional)
DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.recommendAlso: To ensure your password manager doesn’t prompt for  passkeys, we recommend also
DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.removeFromManager: removing the passkey from your password manager.
DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.moreInformation: For more information on how to do this, see the help centre of your password manager provider.
